verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents an official hosted MCP server with OAuth that gives agents error investigation and BadgerQL query capabilities, plus a Faults API that lists faults per project. Together these cover pulling and triaging production errors. Filing into trackers is supported through detailed issue exports to GitHub, GitLab and Jira, but nothing shows an agent can trigger those exports through the API or MCP. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that stack traces/notice details are returned via API/MCP, ranking of 'top' issues, agent-driven issue creation in trackers via MCP/API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
